content:
Priya M: FYI support is still getting questions about whether retention is global or per-region. Also the KMS badge in the project header has no affordance to show which region the key lives in. Can we do a microcopy + UI tweak? :thinking_face:

Sam K: agree. problem is twofold: copy ambiguity + cramped badge. users expect to see region scope immediately.

Priya M: sketch of copy i think would help support: 
```
Label: "Storage & retention"
Helper: "Retention applies to logs and analytics. Embeddings and model artifacts are stored in the selected storage region."
Region label: "Artifact storage region"
KMS popover CTA: "View key details"
KMS badge short: "KMS: customer-managed" (info icon)
```
Keep the badge short, expose details in the popover where we can show masked key id and region.

Jorge L: accessibility thing: current keyboard flow jumps past the info icon entirely. Proposed order: Region selector -> KMS info -> Retention input -> Save. I can add role="button" and proper tabindex on the info icon. Small snippet: `infoIcon.setAttribute('role','button'); infoIcon.tabIndex = 0;`

Aisha R: can we also include an explicit aria-describedby on the retention field that references the helper copy? Screen reader users sometimes don't get the helper text. e.g. `retentionInput.setAttribute('aria-describedby','retentionHelp')`.

Sam K: good call. also audit log text needs to be clearer. current entry: `encryption setting updated` — too vague. suggestion: `KMS updated: key rotated by {{actor}} (region: {{region}})` so it's searchable.

Priya M: +1 on audit phrasing. Support likes seeing region inline. Also please mask key id in UI: show last 6 chars only, e.g. `••••-abcd12`. full ARN in popover only for users with cluster-read permission.

Aisha R: small note on timestamps in audit logs: for screen readers prefer full readable label. We should keep relative time visually but add `aria-label` with full date/time and timezone. Example: `<time datetime="2026-03-22T09:12:00Z" aria-label="March 22, 2026 at 9:12 AM UTC">3h ago</time>`.

Jorge L: i'll add a11y unit tests to check tab order and aria-describedby. will spin a quick PR.

Sam K: UX question: show region on badge vs popover? my take: badge short + info icon that opens a small anchored panel listing: Key owner, Key region, Key id (masked), rotation schedule, last rotation. keeps header clean.

Priya M: agreed. add microcopy for popover header: `Key details (customer-managed)` and CTA to `Manage key` that opens the KMS console link.

Aisha R: can we also show a tiny inline hint when the selected storage region differs from the account default: `Artifacts are stored in eu-west-1 (different from account default: us-east-1)` - helps reduce surprise.

ops-bot: environment deploy:staging succeeded for feature/kms-popover (build 4821). :white_check_mark:

Sam K: timeline? i'd like this before next week so docs & support can update.

Jorge L: i'll aim to merge PR by EOD tomorrow, then QA & staging review.

Priya M: cool. action items: Sam finalize copy variants, Jorge implement tab/focus + a11y tests, Aisha update audit timestamp aria-label pattern, i'll coordinate with support for the help article.

Sam K: draft copy variant A (preferred): `Storage & retention — Retention applies to logs and analytics. Embeddings and artifacts are kept in the selected storage region.`

Sam K: variant B: `Data retention (logs & analytics). Embeddings/artifacts stored in chosen storage region.`

Aisha R: prefer A for clarity.

Priya M: thanks all, tagging @support for FYI. :pray:
